title: Gate type language
statement: For a circuit family and a gate type $t$ (or absence of a gate type), the corresponding language consists of strings encoding a pair of a unary string of $n$ true symbols and the binary representation of a natural number $i$, for some $n$ and $i$, such that $i$ is strictly less than the circuit size at $n$ and vertex $i$ has type $t$ in that circuit.
hypotheses_covered: The string has the specified pair encoding
$i$ is strictly less than the circuit size at $n$
